name: skill-security-chat
description: Chat-web security audit of agent skills from HTTPS URLs, uploads, paste, and name resolution. Emits security-report when evidence exists. Does not plan remediation.

inputs.name: user-message
inputs.description: Free-form chat. MAY include URLs, attachments, pasted skill text, skill names, or registry package ids.

outputs.name: reply
outputs.description: User-visible markdown in the user's language.

outputs.name: security-report
outputs.description: Structured security report; empty when there is no usable evidence.
